mapper.select: SELECT m.my_place_id AS id, p.id AS place_id, p.name, p.biz_type AS category, CASE WHEN 'food' THEN '식당' WHEN 'bar' THEN '식당' WHEN 'cafe' THEN '카페' ELSE '놀거리' END AS "group", p.address, p.latitude AS lat, p.longitude AS lng, p.rating, p.review_count, p.image_url, m.from_name, TO_CHAR(m.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at FROM my_place m JOIN retrip_place p ON p.id = m.place_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.my_place_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retrip_place WHERE id = #{placeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_place (member_id, place_id, from_name) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{placeId}, #{fromName}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, place_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM my_place WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
